lines.beaver_en: Hello. How can I help you?
lines.en: Hello. I'd like to exchange money.

lines.beaver: 네, 어느 나라 돈으로 바꿔 드릴까요?
lines.beaver_en: Sure, which currency would you like?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, eoneu nara doneuro bakkwo deurilkkayo?
lines.en: I want to change dollars into Korean money.

lines.beaver_en: How much would you like to exchange?
Yes, there's a small fee. Is that okay?
lines.en: Yes, that's fine. Please give it in cash.

lines.beaver_en: Here you are. Do you need coins too?
Would you like to open a bankbook as well?
lines.en: Yes, I want to save money.

lines.beaver_en: Sure. Shall I make you a card too?
lines.en: Thank you. I get my salary next month.

lines.beaver_en: When you get paid, how much will you save?
lines.learner: 반쯤 저금하고 싶어요. 부자가 됐으면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: I want to save about half. I wish I could be rich.
lines.roman: banjjeum jeogeumhago sipeoyo. bujaga dwaesseumyeon joketseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: If you save well, you'll become rich.
lines.learner: 그런데 친구한테 빌린 돈도 갚아야 해요.
lines.en: But I also have to pay back money I borrowed from a friend.
lines.roman: geureonde chinguhante billin dondo gapaya haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Here are your bankbook and card.
lines.en: I hope I earn a lot of money. Thank you!
